latestVersion.changelog:
Alibaba Cloud Model Setup 0.1.4 — major update with Coding Plan support and improved model/site options.

- Fixed provider name typo: now consistently "bailian" (was "balian").
- Added support for both Pay-As-You-Go and Coding Plan subscriptions, with 5 site endpoints instead of 3.
- Expanded and clarified available model list: flagship Qwen series, new Qwen3 models, and Coding Plan–exclusive third-party models.
- Updated workflow: choose plan type, select site, improved API key validation and model selection steps.
- Example config output and validation steps refreshed for new provider name, models, and plan logic.
